add_calendar_event: add a calendar event with title, start/end datetime, tag, description, location, and attendees
get_calendar_event: get a single calendar event by its event ID and return all event details
delete_calendar_event: delete a calendar event from the calendar by its event ID
get_calendar_events_from_to: get calendar events overlapping a specified date range with offset and limit pagination
search_events: search calendar events by partial match in title, description, location, or attendees
